name: AnonyViet Floating Banner
author: anonyviet

sections.description:
AnonyViet Floating Banner displays an eye-catching floating banner fixed to the right side of the screen:

  • Sway animation – the banner gently swings back and forth to grab attention, with adjustable angle and speed.
  • Show/hide cycle – the banner flies in, stays for a few seconds, slides out, and repeats on your schedule.
  • Respectful dismissal – when a visitor clicks the × button, the choice is saved in a cookie (plus a localStorage backup) and the banner never shows again for them.
  • Random rotation – add multiple banner images and destination links; each page view shows a random image with a random link, chosen independently.
  • Redirect link builder – wrap destination links with random prefixes and suffixes to build redirect or campaign URLs. Example: prefix https://xyz.com/url= + link https://abc.com + suffix &123 → https://xyz.com/url=https://abc.com&123.
  • Click statistics – see which destination links get clicked and which posts or pages the clicks come from, broken down by day, week and month, with bar charts. History is kept for 60 days and can be cleared with one click.
  • Referrer privacy – banner links use rel="noreferrer", so the destination site never sees which site the click came from.

All settings live under Settings → AnonyViet Floating Banner; statistics under Settings → Thống kê Floating Banner. No coding required.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the fly-banner folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → AnonyViet Floating Banner to add banner images, destination links, prefixes/suffixes, and adjust the animation.
  4. View click statistics under Settings → Thống kê Floating Banner.
sections.faq:
The banner still shows on other pages after I click ×. Why?

The dismissal is stored in a first-party cookie. Make sure your browser allows cookies, and note that www.example.com and example.com do not share cookies — use one canonical domain for your site.

Does the destination site know where clicks come from?

No. Banner links include rel="noreferrer", so the browser sends no Referer header. Affiliate parameters inside your own link still work normally.

How long is click history kept?

60 days. Older records are deleted automatically, and you can wipe the history at any time from the stats page.

Can I use different images and links?

Yes. Add as many banner images and destination links as you like — each page view picks a random image and a random link independently. You can also add multiple random prefixes and suffixes to build redirect URLs.

  • CSS and JavaScript are now loaded through wp_enqueue_style/wp_enqueue_script (wp_add_inline_style/wp_add_inline_script); no more inline

1.1.1

  • Dismissal hardening: pending timers are cleared on close, the cookie is written with both max-age and expires, and a missing cookie self-heals from localStorage.

1.1.0

1.0.0
